title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Dealer Sale Card: Vehicle Limits, Terms and Retail Price Range
content:
Each Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan may be sold only within its own vehicle limits, on one of its own terms and at a retail price inside its own range. The vehicle's age is the purchase year less the vehicle's model year, in years; the odometer is the reading at purchase, in miles; the mileage term is the miles of coverage added to the odometer at purchase.

## Vehicle limits at purchase

| Plan | Oldest vehicle age at purchase (years) | Highest odometer at purchase (miles) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 10 | 125000 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 8 | 100000 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 7 | 90000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 6 | 75000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 5 | 60000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 4 | 45000 |

## Terms that may be sold

| Plan | Terms in months | Mileage terms (miles of coverage) |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 36, 48, 60, 72 | 36000, 48000, 60000 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 36, 48, 60, 72, 84 | 48000, 60000, 75000 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 48, 60, 72, 84 | 60000, 75000, 100000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 48, 60, 72, 84, 96 | 60000, 75000, 100000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 60, 72, 84, 96 | 75000, 100000, 125000 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 72, 84, 96, 120 | 100000, 125000 |

## Retail price range, financing and commercial use

| Plan | Lowest retail price (USD) | Highest retail price (USD) | Price may be financed in a Kestrel contract or lease | Vehicle used commercially may be covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 895.00 | 2495.00 | Yes | No |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 1295.00 | 3195.00 | Yes | No |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 1595.00 | 3695.00 | Yes | No |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 1895.00 | 4495.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 2295.00 | 5295.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 2895.00 | 6495.00 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the card

- The age and odometer figures are maximums: a vehicle at exactly the figure shown is within the limit, and one above it is not.
- A term is chosen from the plan's own row in months and from the plan's own row in miles; a figure that appears only in another plan's row is not a term of this plan.
- Financing is available on every plan; a vehicle used commercially may be covered only on Kestrel Care Platinum, Kestrel Care Platinum Plus and Kestrel Care Platinum Elite.
